1.consolidated_definition: Prevenir: sustantivo que designa una acción o medida adoptada con el fin de evitar que algo suceda o se produzca.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Preventive measure or action taken to avoid the occurrence of something.

Alternatively:

Prevention: noun designating an action or measure adopted with the intention of preventing something from happening or occurring.

Or:

Precautionary step or measure taken to prevent a particular event or situation from arising.

reference_definitions: Prepararse. “Tú te aprevienes el sábado.” Meléndez Muñoz.
